rationale: The assistant correctly prioritised isolating power at the consumer unit and avoiding the plug, which matches the expected safety stop, and it sent the customer to an electrician. It did not clearly identify the washing-up liquid as the cause of the foam leak, and it never advised running rinse cycles, using only dishwasher detergent, or telling the landlord. It also made a questionable claim that soapy water is more conductive, said 'Unplug the extension lead' after power-off (acceptable), and over-escalated to a dishwasher technician. The first reply speculated about hoses and pump seals, and the advice to switch off the whole house was reasonable.
